(“CNSREIT OP” or the “Operating Partnership”), a Delaware limited partnership of which we are the general partner, unless the context requires otherwise. We are a Maryland corporation formed on July 18, 2022. We were formed primarily to acquire high-quality, stabilized real estate assets primarily within the United States (“U.S.”). We also invest, to a lesser extent, in real estate equity (including listed REITs), preferred equity and debt instruments.
